body_text: Child, parent and teacher form one connected triangle that nurtures the whole child.

items.title: A Shared Language
items.text: When home and school share love, respect, care and encouragement, children feel secure to explore, make mistakes and grow into confident learners.

items.title: Continuous Communication
items.text: Teachers and parents keep sharing observations for consistent support at home and at school.

items.title: A Community Around Every Child
items.text: Ananya Tots goes beyond education to build a supportive community around every child.
